headings: The New Membership Program: Growth Meets Rewards
sections.visibleText: The New Membership Program: Growth Meets Rewards | Elevate your membership tiers with the Growth System. Fuel your Off-Grid rewards with the Rewards System.

NEW MEMBERSHIP | Elite tiers are purely driven by your cumulative Renogy Miles via the Growth System, entirely separated from spendable assets. | Spend your Renogy Rays freely within the Rewards System without ever lowering your tier status or losing Miles-driven perks. | Enjoy guaranteed monthly coupons and exclusive access to periodic member events. | Steady daily actions build your Miles, while hitting major off-grid milestones unlocks high-value Rays. | LEGACY MEMBERSHIP | Tiers were determined by your active Rays balance, mixing growth tracking with spendable points. | Redeeming Rays for rewards directly reduced your balance, which could lower your tier level. | Perks were mostly limited to one-time coupons, lacking predictable, recurring rewards. | Supported solar and app tracking, but Rays were rewarded within a fragmented, unstructured framework.

collapsedDrawers: What is the new Renogy Membership Program, and why did we upgrade it? The new Renogy Membership Program is an advanced ecosystem tailored for our dedicated community of Off-Grid solar users and builders. We upgraded the legacy structure to separate your long-term loyalty standing from your everyday spendable rewards. This transition introduces a dual-system structure: Growth System (Renogy Miles) that determine your tier standing and benefits, and Rewards System (Renogy Rays) that serve as your spendable digital currency for solar gear, discounts, and exclusive perks.

What is the difference between the new program and the legacy one? The legacy program relied on a single point pool where spending your Rays accidentally downgraded your membership level. The new program solves this pain point completely through a strict structural split:Legacy System: Points (Renogy Rays) accumulated and dropped simultaneously; spending points reduced your tier status.New System (Dual Structure):Renogy Miles (Growth System): Acquired through long-term engagement, solar generation, and official online store purchases. These accumulate as milestone metrics, dictate your Tier Level, can never be spent, and only expire after a fixed 2-year rolling window. Renogy Rays (Rewards System): Mainly acquired through long-term engagement, and official online store purchases. High-frequency, spendable digital currency used directly in the Rewards Marketplace to claim free products, gift cards, and coupons. Spending Rays has zero impact on your tier.

How do I join the Renogy Membership Program? Is there any fee? At the current stage, registration and enrollment in the Renogy Membership Program are completely free. Any user who creates a verified account on our official online store or Renogy APP is instantly enrolled.

Can I use the same account to sync my membership across the Renogy official online store, Renogy App, and Forum? Yes, absolutely. Renogy uses a Single Sign-On (SSO) unified account structure. By logging in with a single credential, your entire membership profile, active tier standing, accumulated Renogy Miles, and spendable Renogy Rays are perfectly synchronized in real-time across the Renogy official online store, the official Renogy App, and the Renogy Forum.

Can I combine Renogy Miles or Rays from multiple different Renogy accounts? No. Renogy Miles and Renogy Rays are strictly non-transferable and tied exclusively to the unique account that performed the initial transaction or engagement task. Merging balances from separate profiles or transferring assets between user accounts is strictly prohibited.

What is the Growth System and Renogy Miles? The Growth System is our tiered ladder that measures your ongoing loyalty and contribution to the Renogy ecosystem. Your position on this ladder is dictated by your Renogy Miles. Miles function as a contribution ledger. They can only be added or subtracted due to returns; they can never be spent as cash or traded for coupons. As your Miles grow, you unlock higher premium tiers that grant richer financial perks and honorary platform status.

How can I check my Renogy Membership tier and Miles balance? You can verify your real-time status instantly through two primary methods:Official Online Store: Log in to your profile and access the dedicated "Renogy Membership" dashboard to see your current Tier Level and Miles history.Renogy App : Open the application, log in, and tap the "Me" icon located in the bottom-right personal navigation center. Your tier status and active Renogy Rays balances will be prominently on your user card.

How can I get my tier benefits? Perks are automatically delivered across three distinct operational categories:Financial Perks: One-time milestone adjustments are directly injected into your active balance. Recurrent, periodic benefit coupons are pushed automatically into your personal digital "Wallet" within the Account Center. Exclusive tier-based discounted pricing on our official webstore activates instantly at checkout the moment you sign into a qualifying tier profile.Honorary Recognition: Personalized profile badges and forum flair are applied automatically based on your real-time tier level.Member Care: Milestone rewards, brand anniversary gifts, and specialized birthday month coupons are automatically generated and deposited directly into your balance and digital Wallet during the respective anniversary or birthday month.
